name: ai_content_studio_prompts
description: Reusable prompt pack derived from the ai_content_studio capability.

prompts.name: script_generation
prompts.template: Write a detailed YouTube video script on the topic: {script_topic}
prompts.use_case: YouTube creators seeking to automate video content production

prompts.name: voiceover_generation
prompts.template: Generate a natural-sounding voiceover audio for the following script: {generated_script}
prompts.use_case: Marketing teams needing to produce video content at scale

prompts.name: video_creation
prompts.template: Create a video combining this voiceover audio and the following visual assets: {video_assets}
prompts.use_case: Businesses automating explainer or promotional video generation

prompts.name: upload_video
prompts.template: Upload the video titled '{video_title}' to YouTube using the provided credentials.
prompts.use_case: Content creators wanting hands-free channel growth automation
